description: The pie chart represents the distribution of different types of stimuli used in a study on generative AI's use in journalism. There are a total of 10 slices, each representing a different type of stimulus. The largest slice is for 'Draft/Other' at 26.4%, followed by 'Press Release' at 18.7%, 'External News Article' at 18.1%, 'Interview' at 8.8%, 'Event Posting' at 6.6%, 'Organizational Report' at 7.7%, 'Organizational Website' at 4.9%, 'Intra-agency news article' at 4.9%, 'Email' at 2.7%, and the smallest slice is 'Social Media Post' at 1.1%. The chart does not include a legend, and the percentages are labeled directly on the slices. The slices are not visually emphasized in any particular way, and the chart does not appear to be ordered in any specific manner.
